narration: 計画では、ハンター5、6人が山でクマの足跡を探し追跡。
asset_type: キャラアニメーション
scene: 雪の尾根道に続く足跡を追う計画の捜索隊6人（CHAR-05・CHAR-09を含む）。台本どおり残雪を描く。

fences.label: キャラプロンプト（1:1）:
fences.text: (CHAR-05 再利用) [Generic group] Cute cartoon character design, thick black outlines, flat cel-shaded colors, large expressive eyes, children's animation style. Exactly six full-body Japanese hunters walking toward the viewer in a loose staggered line, heads bent to scan the ground, all faces clearly visible. Left to right: 1) (CHAR-05 再利用) a Japanese local hunter in his 60s with short grey hair and a grey stubble, an orange cap, a dark green field jacket under a blaze-orange safety vest, khaki trousers and brown boots, pointing down at the ground, eyebrows driven down hard, eyes narrowed and sharp, mouth open giving an order; 2) (CHAR-09 再利用) a Japanese young hunter in his 30s with short black hair, a dark green cap, a dark green field jacket under a blaze-orange safety vest, khaki trousers and brown boots, eyes wide and alert, sweat on his temple; 3) a Japanese hunter in his 50s, heavy-set, a brown cap, a brown jacket under a blaze-orange vest, jaw clenched, eyebrows pulled together; 4) a Japanese hunter in his 40s, tall and thin, a black knit hat, a navy jacket under a blaze-orange vest, eyes darting, mouth tight; 5) a Japanese hunter in his 60s, short and stocky, a grey cap, a khaki jacket under a blaze-orange vest, CLEAN-SHAVEN, frowning hard with sweat on his brow; 6) a Japanese hunter in his 30s, medium build, a red cap, an olive jacket under a blaze-orange vest, eyebrows raised, eyes wide and tense. Each has a rifle slung on the back pointing upward. Exactly six, count them 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Do NOT draw fewer than six. NO TWO OF THEM SHARE A FACE, A HAIRSTYLE OR AN OUTFIT. No two of them are the same height. All are tense and focused, NOT calm, NOT smiling. No lettering, no badge, no logo. Each figure has a very large head about one third of the total height, a short compact torso and short stubby arms and legs, roughly three heads tall. Do NOT draw them with realistic adult proportions — not four, five, six or seven heads tall. Full body. Transparent background, real alpha transparency. 1:1 aspect ratio. Generate 1 image.
